goals.summary: Verify that the intended sitting area is clear before committing to a sitting motion.
goals.semantics: The robot must establish sufficient evidence that the intended support or sitting region is free of a blocking person or object before the sitting action proceeds. The sensing direction, camera motion, body motion, and sensor modality are embodiment-specific strategies rather than part of the portable goal.

goals.summary: Present a held object in an orientation suitable for the intended handover.
goals.semantics: The robot should achieve an acceptable object or end-effector presentation orientation before release or transfer. A particular wrist rotation angle is not portable intent; the target embodiment may satisfy the same goal through different kinematics, grasp selection, or object orientation.
